name: dsh-macos-app
description: DeepSeek Harness macOS desktop wrapper (Electron shell around the local dsh web server)

scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/require-app-not-running.mjs && node scripts/stage-runtime.mjs && node scripts/gen-icon.mjs && node scripts/electron-builder.mjs --mac && node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs && node scripts/make-update-feed.mjs
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: node scripts/require-app-not-running.mjs && node scripts/stage-runtime.mjs && node scripts/gen-icon.mjs && node scripts/electron-builder.mjs --mac --arm64 && node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs --arch arm64 && node scripts/make-update-feed.mjs --arch arm64
scripts.dist:mac:x64: node scripts/require-app-not-running.mjs && node scripts/stage-runtime.mjs && node scripts/gen-icon.mjs && node scripts/electron-builder.mjs --mac --x64 && node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs --arch x64 && node scripts/make-update-feed.mjs --arch x64
